toyota-hiace-h200.title: Engine oil & oil filter
toyota-hiace-h200.notes: To see the maker's own diagram: 1) copy the bus's chassis number (button below); 2) open the maker's diagram link (Partsouq) and paste the number into its search box; 3) find the oil filter page. Then photograph this area on your own bus, add it with Edit picture, and put pins on its parts.
